topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: Walking past the old lot where I first learned to dream under the shade of leaves, I paused. The ground where my childhood friend once stood, proud and tall, is now a stark, open space. I remember the day I planted the seed, a little sapling barely tall enough to earn the title of tree, with hands small and full of hope. It grew with me, our roots intertwined, even though they were miles apart. Now, the space is empty, yet in my heart, the branches still reach high into the sky, casting shadows where no shadows lie. It's a reminder, perhaps, that some parts of us never truly leave the places we've been, the things we've loved.
